program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Rising"; if (t < 0.001) motionState = "Ready to toss"; else if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) motionState = "At the top"; else if (velocity < 0 && height > 0.1) motionState = "Falling"; else if (height <= 0 && t > 0.1) motionState = "Back at launch height"; else if (velocity < 0) motionState = "Falling"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 35, w: 280, h: 330, title: "The motion", state: motionState, id: "lane.motion" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: 35, w: 300, h: 330, title: "Velocity over time", state: "Slope = -g", id: "lane.graph" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 50, y: 60, length: 270, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 330 - (height / 2.2) * 270; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 120, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 120, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 150, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(180, ballY - 25, [`v: ${velocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${acceleration.toFixed(1)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${force.toFixed(1)} N`], { id: "callout.toss" })); const pts = sdk.sample((st) => launchSpeed - gravity * st, 0, Math.min(t, 1.8), 20); const plotSeries = [{ id: "vSeries", points: pts.map((val, idx) => [idx * (1.6 / 20), val]), kind: "line" }]; objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 340, y: 65, w: 260, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: plotSeries })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 470, 310, "Slope = -g", { align: "middle" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.description: An interactive scene showing a ball tossed vertically, displaying its height, velocity vector, acceleration vector, and a velocity-time graph.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
